name: @rip-lang/tray
description: Pure-Rip macOS menu-bar apps rendered by one small reusable SwiftUI host

scripts.test:swift: swift build --package-path macos && swift run --package-path macos tray-kit-check
scripts.build: rip build.rip tray.rip --name Rip --identifier io.ripdev.apps --output dist --force
scripts.demo: RIP_TRAY_RIP=../../bin/rip swift run --package-path macos rip-tray-host tray.rip
